params.prompt: 2D animated history explainer frame, 16:9, no text. Hand-drawn ink illustration, clean black outlines, fine cross-hatching, muted tropical palette of faded canary yellow, sea teal, sun-bleached cream and sepia with small black accents and hot hazy sunlight or warm lamp light. Not gory. Humans are simple STICKMEN: plain white round head, two dot eyes, no nose, no beard, thin black stick arms and stick legs, small black mitten hands, dressed exactly as described for this scene and era; anyone wearing glasses has his two dot eyes INSIDE the lenses and no other eyes. Only the few figures described, standing apart, never overlapping; each has exactly two arms and two hands; every arm comes straight out of its own shoulder and never bends around or behind an object; head, body and feet of each figure face the same way, no twisted bodies; hands are empty unless an object is described; nothing floating; no flags, no banners; no readable text. A dark 1500s Aztec city at night by a lake with stepped temples, ominous: on the left third of the frame a single stickman Aztec man in a white cotton cloak sits weakly against a stone wall, his round head covered in small red spots; the right side of the frame is dark empty misty sky.
